issues.title: Dead of Night can fall into commander selection startup
issues.detail: The staged map previously retained the CMRE CommanderSelectionScreen fallback. The staged headless startup path now removes it and rejects the map-specific selection flag.
issues.resolution: Launcher staging and startup-bearing Galaxy scans passed; packed-map runtime reached loop 5504.

issues.title: Live map does not expose the configured Empire starting units
issues.detail: The final runtime observation exposes the configured Empire starting structure and workers through the project-owned live adapter.
issues.resolution: Custom catalog ids 4382 and 4390 are normalized to SCV and CommandCenter; player 1 retained 15 observed units in the final long run.

issues.title: Live AI actions return NotSupported
issues.detail: The live runner previously sent unsupported vanilla abilities to the custom Empire units.
issues.resolution: The adapter now uses Smart ability 1 for Empire worker gather/move and custom ability 17443 for Empire CommandCenter SCV training; the final run recorded 827 Success results and no failures.

issues.title: Neutral objects are treated as enemy threats
issues.detail: The observation adapter previously admitted neutral objects into the policy threat list.
issues.resolution: Threat selection now requires alliance=Enemy; neutral minerals are retained only as gather targets. The final run's non-neutral action success assertion passed.

issues.title: SC2 API rejects an unpacked staged map directory
issues.detail: The direct directory CreateGame attempt failed. The same staged content packed through StormLib loaded successfully.
issues.resolution: Packed ASCII-path map generation remains a required live runtime precondition and is included in the Stage 15 evidence bundle.
